blind.description: A stylized topiary plant set inside a square planter box. The planter has square corner posts and recessed side panels finished in a light tan wood or stone appearance. Inside the planter is dark brown soil and a small brown wooden trunk supporting three tiers of dense, rounded, conical-stacked green foliage with stylized scalloped leaf detailing. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled.
blind.from_above: Concentric textured green rings forming the foliage tiers, centered within the four corners of a square tan planter box.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet tall (around half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 1.8 feet wide.

notes: Planter box color is light tan/stone rather than grey
